name: evermembench_llm
description: Wraps evermembench's own 'LLM system' baseline (dataset-native, family D) -- full dialogue as context, no memory system -- using upstream's exact dialogue formatting, MC/open-ended prompts, and answer-letter parsing so it reproduces their reported LLM-only numbers faithfully. Scoring is left to this repo's own qa_em/qa_f1/qa_llm_judge metrics rather than upstream's own LLM-judge loop.
author: Wnsdnl
